name: Codex Security
tagline: OpenAI's CLI & SDK for statically scanning repos for security flaws
description: Codex Security is OpenAI's CLI and SDK for statically scanning repositories to surface security flaws. Written in TypeScript, it plugs into the Codex ecosystem to give developers a fast security review pass over their codebase. It targets catching vulnerabilities early in the development loop rather than after release.
highlights: Static scanning of repositories for security flaws
CLI and SDK written in TypeScript
Sits inside the Codex ecosystem for in-loop review
~9.5k stars from the security and agent communities
curatorNote: Security scanning inside the Codex loop makes review a first-class step — strong adoption (9.5k stars) shows how much agents amplifying security checks is wanted.
